source_matrices: E41 arithmetic_inputs and integral Hall substitution

1.coordinate_map: Take the last five coordinates of left_transform*x.

2.coordinate_map: Free coordinate x[0]; subtract x[0]*e0, then take (left*(x-x[0]*e0))[k] modulo3^valuation[k] at positive pivots.
2.inverse_coordinate_map: Place the torsion digits in their positive-pivot positions, apply left_inverse modulo81, then add the free coordinate times e0.

3.inverse_coordinate_map: Place the torsion digits in their positive-pivot positions and apply left_inverse modulo729.
